attempts.summary: Created an SSH host certificate authority on node1, signed node1's ed25519 host key with it, and configured sshd to present the certificate via HostCertificate. Verified that a client trusting only the CA public key (via @cert-authority in known_hosts, with no pinned host key) connects successfully under StrictHostKeyChecking=yes, both before and after a full node restart. Restart evidence protocol completed: boot_id changed from 77765c08-9e99-4943-a086-f1fef3b3188e to f7657926-99af-4e30-9167-a62827113bc3, confirming a genuine reboot, with sshd and the CA/cert files verified healthy (identical file hashes) and CA-based SSH trust re-verified afterward.
